fcs_function.name: nav/count
fcs_function.description: navigators switched on

lag_filter.name: nav/roll-kinematic-deg
lag_filter.description: the bank the turn rate implies, from the flight control system's own yaw-rate gyro: a reference no navigator supplies

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-kinematic-deg
fcs_function.description: the pitch attitude that air data and vertical speed imply

fcs_function.name: nav/roll-mean-deg
fcs_function.description: mean of those switched on

fcs_function.name: nav/roll-mid4-deg
fcs_function.description: of four, the mean of the middle two

fcs_function.name: nav/roll-mid3-deg
fcs_function.description: of three, the middle one

fcs_function.name: nav/roll-nearer-deg
fcs_function.description: of two that disagree, the one nearer the reference

switch.name: nav/select-roll
switch.description: roll: the middle value of three or four; of two, their mean while they agree and the one nearer the reference when they don't; the last value with none

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mean-deg
fcs_function.description: mean of those switched on

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mid4-deg
fcs_function.description: of four, the mean of the middle two

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mid3-deg
fcs_function.description: of three, the middle one

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-nearer-deg
fcs_function.description: of two that disagree, the one nearer the reference

switch.name: nav/select-pitch
switch.description: pitch: the middle value of three or four; of two, their mean while they agree and the one nearer the reference when they don't; the last value with none

switch.name: nav/latch-miscompare
switch.description: two navigators disagree: for the operator. Stays set until nav/miscompare-reset

fcs_function.name: ap/link-age-sec
fcs_function.description: time since the last uplink

switch.name: ap/latch-link-lost
switch.description: the link is lost: set after the timeout while it is being watched, cleared only by switching the watch off

fcs_function.name: ap/stick-pitch
fcs_function.description: with a dead band of 0.05; forward, right and nose right are positive

fcs_function.name: ap/stick-roll
fcs_function.description: with a dead band of 0.05; forward, right and nose right are positive

fcs_function.name: ap/pedal
fcs_function.description: with a dead band of 0.05; forward, right and nose right are positive

fcs_function.name: ap/protected
fcs_function.description: 1 in the protected manual law

fcs_function.name: ap/gain-q
fcs_function.description: gain schedule: control power goes with dynamic pressure

fcs_function.name: ap/schedule-mach
fcs_function.description: the scheduled Mach number above FL220

fcs_function.name: ap/schedule-kcas
fcs_function.description: the scheduled speed as calibrated airspeed at this height: 150 KCAS low down, the scheduled Mach above

switch.name: ap/speed-target-kcas
switch.description: the commanded speed: the schedule less the operator's offset, or a commanded speed

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: angle-of-attack limit: the lift break less a margin

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: bank limit

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-course-deg
fcs_function.description: the leg's course, east of north

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-togo-ft
fcs_function.description: distance to the end of the leg

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-xt-ft
fcs_function.description: cross-track error, right of the leg positive

fcs_function.name: ap/track-error-deg
fcs_function.description: wanted course less ground track

fcs_function.name: ap/ground-error-deg
fcs_function.description: wanted course less heading, on the ground

switch.name: ap/latch-rollout
switch.description: on the runway: set by weight on a main wheel while landing, cleared when landing is switched off

fcs_function.name: ap/approach-keas
fcs_function.description: the speed for a lift coefficient of 0.645 at this weight

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-pitch-deg
switch.description: ruddervator angle at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-yaw-deg
switch.description: yaw command at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-throttle
switch.description: throttle at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-theta-latched-deg
switch.description: pitch attitude at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-error-kt
fcs_function.description: fast is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-manual-deg
fcs_function.description: by hand: the stick asks for a rate, 3 deg/s at full travel or what gives 0.5 g more or less than 1, whichever is less (the governor moves at twice the difference)

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-follow-deg
fcs_function.description: in the direct law the command follows the aircraft, so that coming back is bumpless

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-flare-deg
fcs_function.description: the flare's pitch attitude

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-takeoff-deg
fcs_function.description: takeoff: the attitude on the ground until 130 KIAS, then 7 deg

switch.name: ap/theta-mode-deg
switch.description: pitch attitude asked for by the mode, from the attitude latched at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-ahead-deg
fcs_function.description: angle of attack, looked ahead by hand

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-ahead
fcs_function.description: the factor on speed and Mach number when looked ahead by hand

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-margin-deg
fcs_function.description: room under the angle-of-attack limit

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-margin-kt
fcs_function.description: room above the lowest speed allowed: 15 kt under the commanded speed. Not on the ground: a takeoff starts from rest

fcs_function.name: ap/protect-fast-deg
fcs_function.description: nose up above Mach 0.63 or 175 KCAS

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-rate-deg_sec
fcs_function.description: how fast the pitch command moves: towards the mode's, or down for angle of attack or speed, whichever is lowest; and never past -16 or +18 deg (the integrator behind it has no limit of its own)

pid.name: ap/theta-governor
pid.description: the pitch command, as a change from the attitude latched at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/protect-alpha-deg
fcs_function.description: a direct push down in proportion to the angle of attack over its limit, ahead of the governor

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-error-deg
fcs_function.description: nose high is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/pitch-law-deg
fcs_function.description: ruddervators together, trailing edge down positive

fcs_function.name: ap/pitch-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the angle on entry, the stick, and pitch-rate damping

switch.name: ap/pitch-out-deg
switch.description: on the runway after landing: 3 deg nose-down

fcs_function.name: ap/heading-error-deg
fcs_function.description: right of the nose is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-command-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank command stops at 0.86 of the limit: turning, the bank overshoots its command and then settles above it (a proportional law; an integral was tried and overshot)

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-manual-deg
fcs_function.description: by hand: the stick's position is the bank

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-clipped-deg
fcs_function.description: inside the bank limit

actuator.name: ap/bank-target-deg
actuator.description: the bank command moves at 5 deg/s at most

fcs_function.name: ap/roll-law-deg
fcs_function.description: roll command, right wing down positive

fcs_function.name: ap/beta-error-deg
fcs_function.description: sideslip less the pedals' (nose right is negative sideslip)

fcs_function.name: ap/beta-gated-deg
fcs_function.description: sideslip, faded out below 60 kt: it means nothing at a walk

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-ground-deg
fcs_function.description: on the ground the ruddervators help the nose wheel

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-law-deg
fcs_function.description: ruddervators against each other, nose right positive: damper, sideslip to zero (interconnect with the ailerons: gain 0 for now)

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-error-kt
fcs_function.description: slow is positive

switch.name: ctl/throttle-norm
switch.description: what the engine takes: the laws' throttle when engaged, the throttle command otherwise

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-height-ft
fcs_function.description: height of the glide path here: the leg ends at the aiming point

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-error-ft
fcs_function.description: high is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-sink-error-fps
fcs_function.description: sinking less than the path asks is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/spoiler-glide
fcs_function.description: spoilers hold the glide path: more when high or sinking too little

switch.name: ap/latch-spoiler-base
switch.description: the spoiler setting at the start of the flare

fcs_function.name: ap/flare-sink-wanted-fps
fcs_function.description: the sink wanted in the flare: the approach's, falling with height to 2.3 ft/s at the ground

fcs_function.name: ap/spoiler-flare
fcs_function.description: in the flare the spoilers work on sink rate alone: they come in as far as the sink needs

switch.name: ctl/spoiler-norm
switch.description: spoilers, 0 to 1 (1 is 45 deg)

fcs_function.name: ap/decel-error-g
fcs_function.description: wanted deceleration less the present one

fcs_function.name: ap/brake-taxi
fcs_function.description: taxi: brakes when over the speed, held on when stopped

fcs_function.name: ap/steer-limit
fcs_function.description: nose-wheel travel allowed, falling with speed

fcs_function.name: ap/steer-out-deg
fcs_function.description: the nose wheel: the law's when steering on the ground, the direct command otherwise

switch.name: ctl/pitch-deg
switch.description: both ruddervators, trailing edge down positive: nose down

fcs_function.name: ap/roll-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the stick and roll-rate damping

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the pedals and the yaw damper

switch.name: ctl/roll-cmd-deg
switch.description: roll command, right wing down positive

switch.name: ctl/yaw-deg
switch.description: ruddervators against each other, nose right positive

switch.name: limits/latch-overstress
switch.description: past a limit: load factor 2.5 or -1, 200 KEAS, Mach 0.7. Latched until limits/reset. Load factor counts in the air only: on the wheels it is the gear's
switch.test:
velocities/ve-kts gt 200 velocities/mach gt 0.7
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz gt 2.5
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz lt -1

switch.name: limits/latch-failed
switch.description: past an ultimate: load factor 3.75 or -1.5, 230 KEAS. The structure is taken to have failed
switch.test:
velocities/ve-kts gt 230
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz gt 3.75
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz lt -1.5

fcs_function.name: ctl/aileron-deg
fcs_function.description: ailerons as the aerodynamic tables take them: right trailing edge down positive, which rolls left
